items.title: NEXUS RESORT & SPA KARAMBUNAI, COMBINING DISTINCT LUXURY WITH AUTHENTIC SABAHAN HOSPITALITY
items.content:
Photo Credit: Nexus Resort Karambunai

Nexus Resort & Spa Karambunai, nestled within its own 3,335-acre peninsula, pleasantly combines distinct luxury and authentic Sabahan hospitality. Take in the beauty of our tropical tree-lined driveway leading to the stunning, ethnic-inspired grand lobby as the gentle chimes of local musical instruments set the mood for the perfect beach getaway. Spacious and impeccable landscapes surround all 325 elegantly appointed guestrooms, while a vast range of dining options are available to cater to all. The choices to relax and pamper yourself are endless at Nexus Resort & Spa Karambunai. The award-winning 18-hole championship golf course and exclusive Borneo Spa complement the superb facilities of this magnificent resort which boasts eight restaurants and bars and an almost endless array of leisure and recreational activities for all. With its impressive banqueting and conference facilities, it is ideal for both leisure and business travellers.

Location: Off Jalan Sepangar Bay, Karambunai, Sabah

Distance to City Centre: ~28 km (about 45 minutes) from central Kota Kinabalu

Distance to Airport: ~35 km (about 60 minutes by car from Kota Kinabalu International Airport)


OUR ROOMS

Photo Credit: Nexus Resort Karambunai


Borneo Wing: 64 units of Borneo Garden, 22 units of Borneo Seaview, and 4 units of Executive Suite

Ocean Wing: 64 units of Ocean Deluxe, 38 units of Ocean Nexus Deluxe and 132 units of Ocean Premier

Luxury Villas: 1 unit Presidential Penthouse


Photo Credit: Nexus Resort Karambunai


18-Hole Championship Golf Course:

Nexus Golf Karambunai is one of the premier golf courses on the island of Borneo, specifically in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. It is located within walking distance from Nexus Resort & Spa Karambunai. Designed by the world-renowned American golf course architect, Ronald Fream, Nexus Golf Karambunai is an international championship par 72, 18-hole golf course. It has established itself as one of the most popular golf courses in Sabah for its unique location and design which offers golfers a challenging and enjoyable experience. Nestled between the million-year-old rainforest and the South China Sea, golfers can enjoy the breathtaking views of Mount Kinabalu and the white sandy beach of Karambunai.  The tract’s key characteristics are its undulating fairways and its well-contoured greens across a series of small lakes, waterways, and hillocks — ingeniously crafted to add to its varying degree of difficulty.


Photo Credit: Nexus Resort Karambunai


Facilities & Activities

Pools - 3 outdoor lagoon-style swimming pools, including a kids' pool:

  • Kids Pool: Specifically designed for children below 7 years old, offering a safe, shallow, and highly family-friendly environment.
  • Activity & Adult Pool: Features a depth of 1.2 meters, making it safe for casual swimming and splashing while deep enough to lounge.
  • Design: The three pools connect into a single flowing complex, allowing parents to easily relax on a sunbed while keeping an eye on the children across the different sections.

Features & Amenities

  • Waterslides: The pools are equipped with a few gentle, mini-sized waterslides perfectly sized for younger children.
  • Swim-Up Bar: Features a swim-up bar (Splashes Pool Bar) where you can order tropical drinks and Ice-Cream
  • Floating Rentals: A kiosk is available by the pool where you can rent pool rings and inflatables for a small fee.
  • Towel Service: Complimentary towels are typically provided for hotel guests at the poolside.

Photo Credit: Nexus Resort Karambunai


Recreation: Kayaking, Surfing, Cycling, Nature walk, Batik painting and the Nexie Kids Club.

Nexus Resort & Spa Karambunai offers a host of activities for individuals, families, the young, and the old. Whether you are looking for an idyllic spot to relax, a place to discover the beauty of nature, an outdoor stage to enjoy a performance, or a scenic stretch for you to cycle along, you will be able to find these and more at Nexus Resort & Spa Karambunai.

On land or water, the choices are many and varied. The sprawling outdoor area allows the resort to infuse adventure into your stay, as there is never a dull moment at Nexus Resort & Spa Karambunai.

You can bask under the sun and enjoy the beauty of nature with Nexus Resort & Spa Karambunai’s menu of family-friendly water sports and recreational activities. Delight in the clear, turquoise blue waters of the South China Sea on a kayak, or just laze around in hammocks or bean bags.


Photo Credit: Nexus Resort Karambunai


Wellness: Borneo Spa for traditional massages and wellness treatments.

Borneo Spa inspires relaxation, rejuvenation, and a harmonious equilibrium of body, mind, and spirit through holistic treatments that combine time-tested therapies.

Drawn from age-old traditions of nature healing from both East and West, Borneo Spa strongly believes that by synergising the richness and wonders of nature with the highest standards of all-inclusive holistic therapy, a change of lifestyle for better health and well-being can be attained.

Embark on a healing journey through the wonders and richness of Mother Nature in Borneo with a selection of relaxing, rejuvenating, and soothing treatments available.


Photo Credit: Nexus Resort Karambunai

Dining Options: 8 distinct venues including the Penyu and Kingfisher Restaurants (serving daily buffets), Splashes Pool Bar, and the Sunset Bar & Grill for dining right on the beach.

items.title: THE RED BRICKS OF BUKIT NANAS: A JOURNEY THROUGH KUALA LUMPUR'S CATHOLIC HERITAGE
items.content:
The humid air of Bukit Nanas carries a certain weight, a blend of damp forest earth and the scent of old stone. 

Tucked away from the glass-and-steel glare of modern Kuala Lumpur, a row of weathered red bricks stands as a silent witness to a century of footsteps.

This is not just a street but also a corridor of memory where the echoes of school bells and choir hymns still linger in the heat.


Photo credit: KL The Guide

St. John’s Institution

The journey begins where the red-and-white arches of St. John’s Institution curve along the hillside. Built in 1904, the building feels less like a school and more like a fortress of knowledge. 

Sunlight filters through the corridors, catching the dust motes that dance where generations of "Johannians" once sprinted to class.

While historically a bastion for boys, there is a subtle shift in the rhythm here. 

In the higher forms, the sea of white and green uniforms welcomes girls into the fold, blending the school’s rigid tradition with a more inclusive present.

It is a place of sharp collars and even sharper heritage.


Photo credit: KL The Guide

St. John’s Cathedral

Just a stone’s throw away, the whitewashed walls of the Cathedral of St. John the Evangelist offer a stark, peaceful contrast to the fiery bricks of the school. 

Inside, the city's traffic noise dies away, replaced by the cool, hollow stillness of high ceilings. 

The Parisian stained glass casts fractured patterns of ruby and sapphire across the pews, looking like a vibrant, silent storytelling that has watched over the hill since the late 1800s.


Photo credit: KL The Guide

Further along the slope, the legacy branches out. St. John’s International School carries the same name but speaks a different language of education. 

Here, the halls are shared equally by boys and girls from the very start, a co-educational hum that brings a youthful energy to the ancient hill

It is the evolution of the Lasallian spirit, which means retaining the discipline of the past while looking toward a global horizon.

The Walk Behind the Greenery

To walk this path is to experience a specific kind of KL time travel. 

On one side, the primitive jungle of the forest reserve threatens to reclaim the pavement, while on the other, the Catholic heritage stands firm.

  • The Texture: Rough bricks, smooth marble, and the iron-wrought gates.

  • The Sound: The distant hum of the LRT mixed with the rustle of tropical leaves.

  • The Sight: The KL Tower peeks over the gothic spires, a reminder of how fast the world moves outside this sanctuary.

The red bricks of Bukit Nanas do not just hold up roofs but also hold a narrative. 

It is a story of faith, a story of scholars, and a story of a city that, despite its rush to the future, still keeps its heart tucked away on a quiet, emerald hill.

items.title: A SWEET ESCAPE FOR FAMILIES, FRIENDS AND WEEKEND FUN SEEKERS
items.content:
Some weekends call for something simple: sunshine, laughter, splashes of water and a full day away from the usual routine. Whether you are planning a family day out, a catch up session with friends, or a school holiday activity that keeps everyone entertained, a waterpark day always has a way of bringing out the fun side in people.

Located in Gamuda Cove, SplashMania Waterpark has become one of the most popular waterparks near Kuala Lumpur for families, young adults and groups looking for a refreshing day trip in Selangor. This season, the park feels even more cheerful as it celebrates SplashMania Birthday Bash 2026 with a playful Candyland Tea Party theme.


Photo credit: GL Play

Instead of walking into an ordinary waterpark setup, guests can expect colourful Birthday Bash decorations, sweet inspired props and photo worthy corners around the park. Think pastel colours, lollipop style displays, giant dessert elements and charming birthday touches that make the experience feel fun before you even get on a slide.

For families with children, this is the kind of outing that works well because the day can move at your own pace. Kids can enjoy water play areas, family friendly slides and splash zones, while parents get to join in the fun or take a breather between activities. It is a good option for parents searching for things to do with kids in KL, family activities in Selangor, or school holiday ideas near Kuala Lumpur.


Photo credit: GL Play

For those who prefer something more energetic, SplashMania also offers thrill-focused attractions such as Plunge, Monsta and Maniac Racer. These are the rides that turn a normal weekend outing into the kind of day where everyone compares who screamed the loudest. For friend groups, couples and young adults, it is an easy way to turn the usual cafe plan into something more memorable.

Photo credit: GL Play

Photo credit: GL Play

Of course, no lifestyle outing is complete without photos. With the Birthday Bash decorations adding a brighter and more whimsical look to the park, guests can capture plenty of cheerful moments between rides. From entrance displays to Candyland-inspired corners, the whole experience gives visitors more than just water slides. It gives them a reason to slow down, snap a few memories and enjoy the atmosphere.


Photo credit:  GL Play 

The celebration also comes with a limited-time online exclusive offer. From now until 31 July 2026, guests can enjoy Buy 1 Free 1 SplashMania tickets when they purchase online at glplay.com.my. For families, best friends or group outings, this makes it an even better time to plan a visit.

Whether you are looking for a waterpark near KL, a fun family day out in Selangor, or a weekend activity that everyone can enjoy together, SplashMania Birthday Bash offers a cheerful mix of thrills, water play, birthday-themed decorations and great value.


Photo credit:  GL Play

SplashMania Birthday Bash 2026 is happening now until 31 July 2026 at SplashMania, Gamuda Cove. Tickets are available online at glplay.com.my.
